what: Rigor lens on the pre-registered H1/H2/H3 conditioning claims
discipline: Applies the SAME registered +5pp clustered rule, and adds (a) a cluster-bootstrap 95% CI on each amplification and (b) BH-FDR + Bonferroni correction across the three hypotheses tested together.
SAMPLE_NOTE: The pre-registration was run once on 20 events (frozen: data/registered_sample_n20.csv, REGISTERED_SAMPLE.md). The corpus has since grown to 253 events (history to 1987). Per Joe's decision, this is an expanded re-test reported ALONGSIDE the frozen n=20 anchor (not a new pre-registration). Verdicts that changed vs the n=20 record: ['H1', 'H2'] -- reported honestly, not overwritten.
honest_note: At N ~ 90 episodes the bootstrap CIs are wide by construction -- a small sample cannot promote a claim to a confident edge. The value here is honesty about uncertainty, and the multiple-testing context: we ran three tests, so a single small p is worth less than it looks.
